title: refactor(driver-sql): the codemod writes applyFilterCondition's return type, so it moves (#30147 phase 2d)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBWMEECkfNfe2VjW9rMJG3n7)_

Part of #30147 (phase 2d, the last of 2a-2d: the codemod writes `applyFilterCondition`'s return type, so it moves. The phase 3 measurement is posted on the card.)

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:codemod 的 `EXPLICIT_RETURN_TYPES` 新增 `applyFilterCondition: 'void'`(取自 base 构建出的 `dist/index.d.ts`),重新生成后它的方法体移到 `sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts`,登记表删去这一条(68 → 67)。
- 为什么改:它留在类上只因为 base 没写返回类型(#30147 第 2d 步,2a 已为同类成员建好这张表)。
- 风险与回滚:方法体逐字节不变(181/181),公开 `.d.ts` 与 base 逐字节相同;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:codemod 里新增的那一行,以及 `sql-driver.ts` 上 `applyFilterCondition` 的 stub。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 21510bba`(`181/181`,退出 0)和 `node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs`(67 条具名例外,退出 0)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位审阅并落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **Codemod (`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`).** `EXPLICIT_RETURN_TYPES` gains `applyFilterCondition: 'void'`. The type is copied from the base `dist/index.d.ts` (`protected applyFilterCondition(builder: Knex.QueryBuilder, condition: any, logicalOp?: 'and' | 'or', tableHint?: string | null, rootFilter?: unknown, options?: DriverOptions): void;`).
- **Regenerated from `21510bba`.** The body of `applyFilterCondition` moves to `sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts`, and the class keeps its signature with `: void` written as a one-call stub. `sql-driver.ts` goes from 9,741 to 9,354 lines. No generated file is edited by hand.
- **Registry.** The row is deleted, so 68 rows become 67.

| card | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| #30020 | 19 | 19 |
| #30054 | 16 | 16 |
| #30055 | 6 | 6 |
| #30147 | 27 | 26 (sql-driver.ts 3 → 2) |
| total | 68 | 67 |

The two `sql-driver.ts` rows left on #30147 are `get supports` and `static DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`. The phase 3 report on #30147 recommends that both stay as accepted exceptions.

## Tests

- No test file changes. The codemod's `--self-test` already pins the `EXPLICIT_RETURN_TYPES` mechanism (battery "codemod-limit retirements (#30147)" from #30249). All 106 cases in 7 batteries pass.
- The suites below ran at base `d3f23d20` and at head; the counts are equal.

| suite | base | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| driver-sql (`vitest run`) | 238 files passed, 12 skipped; 3,859 passed, 216 skipped | the same |
| driver-turso (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 97 files; 2,514 passed, 34 skipped | the same |
| driver-sqlite-wasm (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 40 files; 750 passed | the same |
| cli by-path pins (9 files) | 9 files; 116 passed | the same |
| types / metadata / metadata-protocol by-path tests, spec `check-liveness.test` | 53 / 11 / 33 / 74 passed | the same |

## Acceptance notes

- The facade gate script and its self-test are untouched.
- No changeset, as #30139, #30249, #30306 and #30363 (`skip-changeset`): no published behaviour or surface changes (the public `.d.ts` is byte-identical).

## Verification

Head `322898a6`, base `origin/main` `d3f23d20`.
